user_text: Perfect, that's done. Wow, it's really late.
text:
It really is — 2 AM is deep in the grant-writing trenches! But you've got a solid skeleton to build on now.

A couple of quick suggestions before you close out:

- **Save this somewhere accessible** so you can start filling in sections when you're fresh.
- **Tackle Sections 2 and 4 first** (Need and Program Design) — they carry 60% of the score and will shape everything else.
- **Write the Executive Summary last** once the rest is locked in.

When you're ready to pick back up, I can help you:

- Draft any individual section
- Tighten language to fit a page limit
- Stress-test your narrative against the rubric
- Build the logic model or timeline table

Get some sleep — you'll write a much stronger application rested. Good luck! 🌙
